f3_program: observe(at("company.total_stockholders_equity", "without_adoption_of_new_standard"), 5496, "million_usd", cell("Total stockholders’ equity", "Balances Without Adoption of New Standard"))
assumptions: “As Reported” represents the state after adoption, so the requested increase runs from the balance without adoption to the reported balance.
“Net percentage difference” is interpreted as percentage change from 2017 to 2019.
The two identically labeled “Total” cells are disambiguated by their surrounding December 31, 2018 and December 31, 2019 section headings.
Parenthesized allowance amounts are represented as negative values.
The requested change is ordered chronologically from 2017 to 2018.
The parenthesized 2018 amount is represented as negative.

f3_program: observe(at("mgi.total_fair_value_of_consideration_transferred", "estimated_at_june_30_2019"), 3757, "thousand_usd", cell("Total fair value of consideration transferred", "Estimated at June 30, 2019"))

observe(at("mgi.total_fair_value_of_consideration_transferred", "final_as_of_december_31_2019"), 3777, "thousand_usd", cell("Total fair value of consideration transferred", "Final as of December 31, 2019"))
assumptions: The requested change follows the question’s order from the June 30 estimate to the December 31 final value.
